nodes.description: Ownable._owner: address of the contract owner, zeroed by renounceOwnership
mapping(address=>uint256) of reflection-based token balances
mapping(address=>uint256) declared but unused token balances
ERC20 allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount
mapping marking addresses exempt from transfer tax and cooldown
mapping(address=>bool) blacklist controlled by the owner
mapping(address=>uint) per-buyer cooldown timestamps
total reflection supply _rTotal
accumulated fee tokens _tFeeTotal
_feeAddr1: tax percent applied to the transfer fee portion
_feeAddr2: tax percent applied to the team/marketing portion
_feeAddrWallet1: payable marketing wallet receiving half of ETH
_feeAddrWallet2: payable marketing wallet receiving half of ETH
IUniswapV2Router02 router instance used for swaps and liquidity
liquidity pair address created in openTrading
flag preventing openTrading from being called twice
inSwap reentrancy guard flag set by lockTheSwap
swapEnabled flag enabling automatic swap-and-send during transfers
cooldownEnabled flag enabling max-tx and cooldown restrictions
_maxTxAmount: maximum tokens per buy while cooldown is active
Context._msgSender(): returns msg.sender
Ownable.renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner, sets _owner to address(0)
Ownable.owner(): returns the current _owner
onlyOwner modifier: requires _owner == _msgSender()
ERC20 transfer(recipient, amount): calls _transfer with _msgSender()
ERC20 transferFrom(sender, recipient, amount): moves tokens and reduces allowance
ERC20 approve(spender, amount): sets allowance for _msgSender()
ERC20 allowance(owner, spender): reads _allowances
ERC20 balanceOf(account): converts reflections via tokenFromReflection
ERC20 totalSupply(): returns constant _tTotal
setCooldownEnabled(bool) onlyOwner: toggles cooldownEnabled
tokenFromReflection(rAmount): converts reflection amount to token amount using _getRate
_approve(owner, spender, amount): writes allowance and emits Approval
_transfer(from,to,amount): tax, blacklist, cooldown, maxTx logic plus swap-back and ETH send
swapTokensForEth(tokenAmount): approves router and swaps tokens for ETH, guarded by lockTheSwap
sendETHToFee(amount): splits ETH to two fee wallets via transfer
openTrading() onlyOwner: sets router, creates pair, adds liquidity, enables trading
setBots(address[]) onlyOwner: adds addresses to the blacklist
removeStrictTxLimit() onlyOwner: restores full _maxTxAmount
delBot(address) onlyOwner: removes an address from the blacklist
_tokenTransfer(sender,recipient,amount): dispatches to _transferStandard
_transferStandard(sender,recipient,tAmount): updates reflection balances, takes team fee, reflects fee
_takeTeam(tTeam): converts team tokens to reflections credited to the contract
_reflectFee(rFee,tFee): reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal
manualswap(): swaps the contract token balance, gated only by _msgSender()==_feeAddrWallet1
manualsend(): sends contract ETH to fee wallets, gated only by _msgSender()==_feeAddrWallet1
_getValues(tAmount): computes token and reflection transfer amounts
_getTValues(tAmount,taxFee,TeamFee): percentage math for tFee, tTeam, tTransferAmount
_getRValues(tAmount,tFee,tTeam,currentRate): multiplication/addition math to reflection amounts
_getRate(): computes rSupply/tSupply ratio
_getCurrentSupply(): returns reflection and token supply snapshot
lockTheSwap modifier: sets inSwap true around the wrapped call
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, allowances and fee-wallet checks
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time used for cooldowns and swap/liquidity deadlines
External call uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens before state finalization
External ETH transfer to _feeAddrWallet1/_feeAddrWallet2 from sendETHToFee
External payable call uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH in openTrading
manualswap/manualsend privileged operations gated only by an equality check against _feeAddrWallet1 instead of onlyOwner
from parameter of _transfer
to parameter of _transfer
amount parameter of _transfer
recipient parameter of transfer
tokenAmount parameter of swapTokensForEth
amount parameter of sendETHToFee
bots_ address array parameter of setBots
notbot parameter of delBot
tAmount parameter of _getValues
contractTokenBalance local in _transfer holding balanceOf(address(this))
contractETHBalance local in _transfer holding address(this).balance
path array [token, WETH] built in swapTokensForEth
currentRate local in tokenFromReflection from _getRate
_uniswapV2Router local router instance in openTrading
tTeam local in _getTValues feeding _takeTeam

edges.reason: _msgSender returns msg.sender directly
onlyOwner compares _owner against _msgSender()
transfer forwards _msgSender() as the sender
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender for allowance reduction
approve uses _msgSender() as allowance owner
manualswap requirement compares _msgSender() to _feeAddrWallet1
manualsend requirement compares _msgSender() to _feeAddrWallet1
renounceOwnership writes _owner = address(0)
onlyOwner reads _owner for the authorization check
_transfer reads owner() to decide fee and bot checks
openTrading passes owner() as the liquidity recipient
transfer invokes _transfer
transferFrom invokes _transfer
recipient parameter flows into the transfer call
from parameter drives blacklist, pair and cooldown branches
to parameter drives pair and cooldown branches
amount parameter is compared to _maxTxAmount
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee for sender and recipient
_transfer requires !bots[from] && !bots[to]
_transfer reads and writes cooldown[to] using block.timestamp
_transfer compares from/to with uniswapV2Pair
_transfer branches on swapEnabled
_transfer branches on the inSwap reentrancy guard
_transfer branches on cooldownEnabled
_transfer requires amount <= _maxTxAmount
_transfer assigns the tax percentage _feeAddr1
_transfer assigns the team percentage _feeAddr2
_transfer performs an inline swap of the contract balance during a token transfer
_transfer sends accumulated ETH to fee wallets during a token transfer
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer
cooldown[to] = block.timestamp + 30 seconds makes the restriction timestamp dependent
swap deadline is passed as block.timestamp
addLiquidityETH deadline is passed as block.timestamp
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call
swapTokensForEth is protected by the lockTheSwap flag toggling
swapTokensForEth reads uniswapV2Router for WETH and swap
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping
tokenAmount parameter determines the swap input
path array is passed as calldata to the router swap
sendETHToFee performs external ETH transfers to the fee wallets
amount parameter is split with div(2) between the fee wallets
_feeAddrWallet1 is the transfer target, an external call to a payable address
_feeAddrWallet2 is the transfer target, an external call to a payable address
openTrading stores the router address into uniswapV2Router
openTrading creates and stores the liquidity pair
openTrading performs the external addLiquidityETH payable call
openTrading approves the router for the full supply
openTrading sets swapEnabled = true
openTrading sets cooldownEnabled = true
openTrading sets the initial 2 percent _maxTxAmount
openTrading sets tradingOpen = true
local router instance is used for factory, WETH and liquidity calls
setBots writes true into the bots blacklist
bots_ array entries are written into bots
removeStrictTxLimit restores _maxTxAmount to the full supply
delBot clears the blacklist flag for an address
notbot parameter indexes the blacklist mapping
setCooldownEnabled toggles cooldownEnabled which gates cooldown logic
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard
_transferStandard updates _rOwned for sender and recipient
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee
_transferStandard calls _getValues for the amount breakdown
_takeTeam credits reflection team tokens to the contract balance
tTeam local is multiplied by the current rate and credited
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal
_reflectFee adds tFee to _tFeeTotal
_getValues calls _getTValues
_getValues calls _getRValues
tAmount parameter is the base of all amount computations
tAmount is multiplied and divided by fee percentages, risking overflow or truncation
_getValues calls _getRate for the current rate
tFee and tTeam are multiplied by currentRate and subtracted in _getRValues
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply
tokenFromReflection relies on the _getRate ratio
currentRate local is used to divide the reflection amount
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal as the reflection supply
allowance reads the _allowances mapping
balanceOf reads _rOwned before conversion
balanceOf calls tokenFromReflection to convert reflections
manualswap swaps the entire contract token balance
manualswap authorization is only an equality check against _feeAddrWallet1
manualsend authorization is only an equality check against _feeAddrWallet1
manualsend forwards the whole contract ETH balance to sendETHToFee
transferFrom approves the reduced allowance after transferring
approve delegates to _approve
_approve writes the _allowances mapping
router swap can re-enter the transfer path and re-run swap/send logic
ETH transfer to a payable wallet can re-enter receive() and the transfer flow

normalization_plan.reason: from is a parameter of _transfer and only meaningful inside that function
to is a parameter of _transfer and only meaningful inside that function
amount is a parameter of _transfer used for maxTx and tax math
recipient is a parameter of the public transfer function
tokenAmount is the direct input of the swap routine
amount is the direct input of the ETH distribution routine
bots_ is the array consumed by the setBots loop
notbot is the address indexed by delBot
tAmount is the base input of the value computation routine
contractTokenBalance is the exact amount handed to the swap routine
contractETHBalance is the exact amount handed to sendETHToFee
path is the calldata array supplied to the external router swap call
currentRate is only used to divide the reflection amount in that function
_uniswapV2Router exists only inside openTrading to configure the pool
tTeam is the value passed directly into the team fee logic
